record.question: According to the Mizoram Police Act, 2011, what does the term "Internal Security" means?
options: Preservation of sovereignty and integrity of the State from disruptive and anti-national forces from within the State.
Any violent activity of a group using explosives, inflammable substances, firearms in order to achieve its political objectives.
Maintenance of public order during natural disasters.
Protection of the state from external military threats.
